# SeeMeHired

> SeeMeHired is a UK and Ireland-based talent acquisition and applicant tracking system (ATS) designed for in-house recruitment teams to streamline hiring, video interviews, and diversity-focused hiring.

SeeMeHired serves as a comprehensive digital hiring platform connecting employers and job candidates across the UK and Ireland, with particular strength in the care and hospitality sectors. The platform emphasizes automation, diversity inclusion, and ease of use as alternatives to established competitors like Bullhorn and Breezy HR.

## Key Topics

- Applicant Tracking System (ATS)
- Talent Acquisition
- Recruitment Platform
- HR Automation
- Hiring Software
- Job Search Platform
- Diversity & Inclusion

- Onboarding

- Job Listings
